implemented: The HTTP handler passes both revision-envelope values as explicit optional service pins; explicit zero remains a conflicting pin rather than disabling validation.

The service takes owner-scoped joined Audit/finding revision snapshots before reading and after all query and receipt hydration work. Changed revisions reject the page, including its SupportsCurrent assessment selection. Direct unpinned service callers receive the same before/after check.

Provenance rows are checked and closed before receipt hydration. Unique receipt IDs use the existing bounded GetAuditReceipts path in groups of at most 200; record order, repeated receipts and the 201st cursor sentinel are preserved.

Existing first-proposal GetFinding validation, exact payload/hold hydration and all-or-error missing receipt behavior are retained. Public schemas, cursor encoding, authorization and retention policies are unchanged.
regressions: TestFindingProvenanceConsistentReadsWithSingleConnection: MaxConns=1; source proposal, two check attempts and direct verification remain in order with retained deleted-source provenance and exact refs.
Explicit correct pins succeed; zero Audit or finding pins conflict; foreign owner and foreign Audit return not found.

Real SQL tracer commits a current-assessment mutation before provenance query and during exact receipt hydration; each read returns conflict with no partial items, and a fresh read selects the new current assessment.
Empty provenance page also conflicts after an intervening revision mutation.
First page contains 201 distinct receipt identities; following page preserves three records reusing the original receipt. Each source identity, Run ID, RunDeleted and exact ref is checked.
Removing a contributing receipt hold rejects the entire page with ErrNotFound; the same single-connection pool can immediately read the original finding.

TestPublicAuditPaginationBoundary: existing 199/200 pages, 201 HTTP rejection, signed continuations and owner checks remain valid. New real handler/service interleavings independently change Audit or finding revision after envelope reads and receive HTTP 409.
TestAuditFindingReviewHandlersBindCASIdempotencyAndProvenanceRevision additionally verifies both service pins match the returned envelope.
